comparison.objective: Retrieve a charger from behind a box by manipulating its cord; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Tension-aware deformable retrieval around an occlusion versus rigid precision torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Charger released in tray without moving the box versus locked angular accuracy through cycles.
comparison.reason: Occluded cable retrieval does not overlap the candidate's mechanical adjustment ability.
